attorneys: Sherwin A. Hill, Edward T. Goodrich, James McEvoy, Jr. and Harry D. Fenske for appellant., Solicitor General Perlman for the United States; Daniel W. Knowlton, Edward M. Reidy and Daniel H. Kunkel for the Interstate Commerce Commission; and W. T. Pierson -and Frank H. Cole, Jr. for the Baltimore & Ohio Railroad Co. et al., appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Judgment reversed. United States v. Interstate Commerce Comm’n, 337 U. S. 426.

Mr. Justice Frankfurter, Mr. Justice Jackson, and Mr. Justice Burton dissent for reasons stated in the dissenting opinion in United States v. Interstate Commerce Comm’n, 337 U. S. 426, 444.
